item.title: Fed watchdog finds no laws broken in $2.5 billion renovation
item.description: The Federal Reserve inspector general also found no fault with features the White House had called ostentatious and noncompliant.

item.title: DOJ files misconduct complaint against federal judges in Minnesota
item.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche announced the Justice Department filed a judicial misconduct complaint against federal judges in Minnesota.

item.title: Ken Paxton reportedly says Trump's GOP midterm convention hurt him
item.description: GOP Senate candidate Ken Paxton told donors at a fundraiser that President Trump's midterm convention had hurt him politically.

item.title: WATCH: Snow leopard baby reveal
item.description: The Bronx Zoo unveiled a new snow leopard cub named Sarka, which means shark in Nepali.
